notes.title: Patch Notes for Nightmare Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Prevent skipping of intentionally unskippable cutscenes that caused a soft-lock, including the final ending.
[/list]

notes.title: ACHIEVEMENTS BUG FIX
notes.content:
All,

Apologies! For those that don't know, the achievements were broken. The reason for this is that a dependency was missing that was necessary to allow for the Steam integration to work. This should now be fixed once your game updates.

Additionally, we removed a check such that you should still get the achievement even if the game believes you have it unlocked via its own trophy system.

Please contact us at support@thispolo.co.uk or use the community hub if you see anymore bugs creep in.

We value anyone who plays our game immensely and so having something such as the Steam achievements not working was completely unacceptable -- we'll be much more careful in the future. Truly, it was a Nightmare Update in more ways than one.

Love as always,
THISPOLO

notes.title: The 'Nightmare' Update
Smol demo update
notes.content:
Adds some features to the Demo menu that are present in the main game, primarily:
[list]
[*] Slider to reduce screen shake when angry
[*] Additional 'skip' option in dialogue speed
[/list]

There were also a couple of small bug fixes for certain elements not colliding with the mouse cursor correctly

notes.title: Bug fixes n' more
notes.content:
Here's a round of bug fixes and quality of life changes, on the house!

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed potentially game-breaking bug to do with stacked items being added from the quickbar to the longcase
[*] Added some missing interaction text
[/list]

[b]Patches:[/b]
[list]
[*] Items will only be added back to the world if dropped onto the item they were originally placed on
[*] Improved some grammar
[/list]

notes.title: Printersim update
notes.content:
Below is the changelog:

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added an option for adjusting the intensity of the screen shake when angry
[/list]

[b]Patches:[/b]
[list]
[*] Resized some hitboxes
[*] Printer cartridges now easier to place in the holder
[*] Some shadows and lights effects now do not count as part of the item
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the inventory falsely flagging up as full
[*] Fixed stacks of items being reduced to 1 sometimes
[/list]

notes.title: PRINTERSIM RELEASE
notes.content:
Extremely pleased to announce the release of PRINTERSIM!

It has been a long and arduous journey -- almost ten years in fact -- from when this game was conceptualised, its graphics drawn, music made, and practically programmed from scratch. It started with a large cup of coffee as it now ends with a large cup of coffee.

Although its not quite the end, I'm sure. Here's to more games in the future!

Come join the Discord server: https://discord.gg/D7fqhfYx3H

notes.title: Watch the developer scream | Demo Livestream | Out 28th October!
notes.content:
A livestream of the Printersim Demo. Here you'll get to experience all the trials and tribulations befitting a simple Businessdrone- I mean, Businessman... Businessman.

Printersim is a point and click resource management game for windows. In the full game, you have only 14 days to print a full 60 page report for your boss. The only problem is, you don't have enough money and you have no time. You'll have to sell your hard-earned posessions as you slip further and further into insanity. Now get to it, that report won't print itself. Out 28th October.
